email.subject: Two things costing Lighthouse Group new patients
email.body:
Hi Ravi,

I looked at Lighthouse Group Dentistry's site. Two issues likely cost you real patients: there's no online booking, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next practice. And there's no click-to-call on mobile, so people have to manually dial instead of tapping to call from search results.

Smaller issues too: no listed hours, heavy images slowing load time, and an outdated footer.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's losing you patients and what it'd take to fix.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
Northlight Web
